from google.cloud import speech
from speech_client import get_speech_client
from speech_models import TranscriptionRequest, TranscriptionJob

def diarized_transcript(request: TranscriptionRequest) -> TranscriptionJob:
    client = get_speech_client()

    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        language_code=request.language_code,
        enable_speaker_diarization=True,
        diarization_config=speech.SpeakerDiarizationConfig(enable_speaker_diarization=True),
    )
    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(uri=request.audio_uri)

    operation = client.long_running_recognize(config=config, audio=audio)

    return {
        "job_id": operation.operation.name,
        "status": "SUBMITTED",
    }

from google.cloud import speech
from speech_client import get_speech_client
from speech_models import TranscriptionRequest, TranscriptionJob

def timestamped_transcript(request: TranscriptionRequest) -> TranscriptionJob:
    client = get_speech_client()

    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        language_code=request.language_code,
        enable_word_time_offsets=True,
    )
    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(uri=request.audio_uri)

    operation = client.long_running_recognize(config=config, audio=audio)

    return {
        "job_id": operation.operation.name,
        "status": "SUBMITTED",
    }

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform
from vertexai.language_models import TextEmbeddingInput, TextEmbeddingModel
from speech_models import EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResult

def transcript_embedding(request: EmbeddingRequest, project_id: str, location: str = "us-central1") -> EmbeddingResult:
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    model = TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained("text-embedding-004") # Using text-embedding-004

    inputs = [TextEmbeddingInput(text, "SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY") for text in request.text_segments]
    embeddings = model.get_embeddings(inputs)
    
    return EmbeddingResult(embeddings=[embedding.values for embedding in embeddings])
